import Mathlib
/-!
# Line N20 — key finite/arithmetic facts for the H1 (collision lemma) push
Grok Bot, 2026-11-01. No `sorry`, no `native_decide`. Kernel evaluation only (`decide +kernel`, `norm_num`).

§1 carry pair-state graph (exact-collision carries, box |e| ≤ 15, offset coordinates e' = e + 15 ∈ [0,30]):
   reachable states on closed paths (0,0) → (0,0) number 633, all with |e| ≤ 14, and (−14,−14) is one of them.
§2 Collatz–Wielandt certificate: the 0/1 adjacency matrix of the 633-state graph has spectral radius ≥ 20
   (obstruction O1 of REPORT_N20 §4).
§3 Green kernel identities and the integer step |e| < 15 ⇒ |e| ≤ 14.
§4 Tail / KP arithmetic (REPORT_N20 §3): conditional H1 ⇒ H3 bookkeeping.
-/
namespace LineN20

/-! ## 1. Carry pair-state graph -/
/-- transition (a,b) → (b,c) allowed iff |c − 6b + a| ≤ 60; offset coordinates: v = c'+a'−6b'+60. -/
def okb (a b c : Nat) : Bool := Nat.ble (6*b) (c + a + 120) && Nat.ble (c + a) (6*b)
def bit (s : Nat) : Nat := 1 <<< s
/-- one forward step on a bitmask of states s = a'·31 + b' -/
def fstep (F : Nat) : Nat :=
  (List.range 961).foldl (fun acc s =>
    if F.testBit s then
      (List.range 31).foldl (fun acc2 c =>
        if okb (s / 31) (s % 31) c then acc2 ||| bit ((s % 31) * 31 + c) else acc2) acc
    else acc) F
/-- one backward step -/
def bstep (F : Nat) : Nat :=
  (List.range 961).foldl (fun acc s =>
    if F.testBit s then
      (List.range 31).foldl (fun acc2 a =>
        if okb a (s / 31) (s % 31) then acc2 ||| bit (a * 31 + s / 31) else acc2) acc
    else acc) F
def iter (f : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, x => x
  | n+1, x => iter f n (f x)
/-- the carry state (0,0) -/
def seed : Nat := bit (15*31 + 15)
/-- forward-reachable set from (0,0) (40 steps; a fixpoint by `fw_fix`) -/
def FW : Nat := iter fstep 40 seed
/-- backward-reachable set to (0,0) -/
def BW : Nat := iter bstep 40 seed
/-- states on closed paths (0,0) → (0,0) -/
def REACH : Nat := FW &&& BW
def popc (F : Nat) : Nat := (List.range 961).foldl (fun acc s => if F.testBit s then acc + 1 else acc) 0
/-- every state of F has both coordinates in [1,29], i.e. |e| ≤ 14 -/
def inner (F : Nat) : Bool := (List.range 961).all (fun s => !F.testBit s ||
  (Nat.ble 1 (s/31) && Nat.ble (s/31) 29 && Nat.ble 1 (s%31) && Nat.ble (s%31) 29))

theorem fw_fix : fstep FW = FW := by decide +kernel
theorem bw_fix : bstep BW = BW := by decide +kernel
theorem fw_card : popc FW = 769 := by decide +kernel
theorem bw_card : popc BW = 769 := by decide +kernel
theorem reach_card : popc REACH = 633 := by decide +kernel
theorem reach_le14 : inner REACH = true := by decide +kernel
/-- (−14,−14) ↦ offset (1,1), index 32, is reachable: the bound 14 is sharp -/
theorem reach_has14 : REACH.testBit 32 = true := by decide +kernel
theorem seed_in : REACH.testBit (15*31+15) = true := by decide +kernel

def xget (a b : Nat) : Nat := (Xcw.getD a []).getD b 0
/-- (A x)_{(a,b)} = Σ_{c allowed} x_{(b,c)} (x vanishes off REACH) -/
def rowsum (a b : Nat) : Nat := (List.range 31).foldl (fun acc c => if okb a b c then acc + xget b c else acc) 0
/-- x is supported exactly on REACH -/
theorem cw_support : (List.range 961).all (fun s => (REACH.testBit s) == Nat.blt 0 (xget (s/31) (s%31))) = true := by
  decide +kernel
/-- A x ≥ 20 x entrywise, hence ρ(A_REACH) ≥ 20 (Collatz–Wielandt, x ≥ 0, x ≠ 0) -/
theorem carry_cw : (List.range 31).all (fun a => (List.range 31).all (fun b =>
    Nat.ble (20 * xget a b) (rowsum a b))) = true := by decide +kernel

/-! ## 3. Green kernel of 1 − 6S + S² and the strict carry bound -/
theorem lam_mul : (3 + 2*Real.sqrt 2) * (3 - 2*Real.sqrt 2) = 1 := by
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)]
theorem lam_add : (3 + 2*Real.sqrt 2) + (3 - 2*Real.sqrt 2) = 6 := by ring
/-- g(k) = λ^{-|k|}/(4√2): at k = 0, g(−1) − 6 g(0) + g(1) = −1 (the δ-equation, up to sign convention) -/
theorem green_center : (2*(3 - 2*Real.sqrt 2) - 6) / (4*Real.sqrt 2) = -1 := by
  have h : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp; ring
/-- for k ≥ 1: λ^{-(k-1)} − 6 λ^{-k} + λ^{-(k+1)} = λ^{-k}(λ + λ⁻¹ − 6) = 0 -/
theorem green_off (q : ℝ) : q * (3 + 2*Real.sqrt 2) - 6 * q + q * (3 - 2*Real.sqrt 2) = 0 := by ring
theorem carry_strict (e : ℤ) (h : |e| < 15) : |e| ≤ 14 := by
  rcases abs_lt.mp h with ⟨h1, h2⟩
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
